contextualReview.limits: Path classification covers known auth, route, server-action and money-related names; it does not detect every business-logic security surface.

reviewed.rationale: Renders the in-memory service snapshot from the clinic repository with a plain map. It performs no search, filter, query or fetch; the word directory triggered the heuristic. Cardinality is owned by the seeded catalog in src/shared/data/ and by staff edits held in memory only.

In-memory simulation repository with no database, network or browser persistence. Availability is a linear scan over the demo appointment list, bounded by the seeded fixtures plus simulated bookings in one browser session. Production scale, persistence and staff access are undefined per AGENTS.md and are not claimed.

Frozen literal English and Arabic copy for the fixed demo catalog and team. No retrieval, query or user input. The search property is static display text for the example search preview, not a search path.

limits: Static inspection cannot prove production-scale performance.
PASS means bounded source patterns only; validate workload and plans for material risk.

details.note: AST coverage is required for inputs needing the UI boundary gates. Not-applicable means no UI gate inputs were found. Route-size findings remain review prompts; runtime performance/latency is not machine-verified.
